annotations.text:
agentbus tui — chat-client layout.
Left: channels with unread counts, ◆ marks memory channels.
Center: selected channel stream, newest at bottom, 'new' divider at last-seen.
Right: live sessions with heartbeat dot.
Bottom: compose, then status bar.
Overlays dim the main screen and take focus. Border color names the overlay: cyan search, magenta memories, green health. esc closes.
Search never errors on embeddings: the bus falls back to text and sets semantic_unavailable, shown as the amber 'text only' badge.
